name: cf-ssh-mcp
description: SSH MCP server + web dashboard on a single Cloudflare Worker (real SSH over cloudflare:sockets).

scripts.test: vitest run --project unit && vitest run --project worker
scripts.test:integration: bash test/sshd/setup.sh && bash test/sshd/start.sh && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:all: vitest run --project unit && vitest run --project worker && bash test/sshd/setup.sh && bash test/sshd/start.sh && vitest run --project integration
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the SSH passwords and keys you store. Type **any passphrase of at least 32 characters** (for example six random words) or paste the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep a copy somewhere safe and **never change it after adding servers** — stored credentials could no longer be decrypted.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard login sessions. Type **any passphrase of at least 32 characters** that is different from ENCRYPTION_KEY (or `openssl rand -base64 48`). Changing it later only logs you out.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time **setup token, at least 12 characters**, that only you know. After deploying, open the Worker URL: the dashboard asks for this token once to create your admin password, so nobody else can claim your fresh deployment.

DB.description: D1 database for servers, settings, MCP tokens and the audit log (created automatically; migrations run in the deploy command).

SSH_SESSION.description: Durable Object holding one live SSH/SFTP connection per server.

MCP_SESSION.description: Durable Object holding one MCP (Streamable HTTP) session.

AUTH_MODE.description: `password` (default). Use `access` or `both` only together with Cloudflare Access (ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN + ACCESS_AUD).
